facts.text: UH Hilo established Ka Haka ʻUla O Keʻelikōlani in 1998 as the world's first college conducted through the medium of Hawaiian.

sources.title: Ka Haka ʻUla O Keʻelikōlani College of Hawaiian Language
sources.quote: UH Hilo's College of Hawaiian Language, Ka Haka ʻUla O Keʻelikōlani, was established in 1998 as the world's first college through the medium of Hawaiian.
